title: How I freed up 20GB of Google Photos storage with 5 simple steps
summary: Google doesn't make it easy to identify duplicates, but there are some tricks to make clearing space quicker.
body: I have a Google One subscription , so I get more than the standard 15GB of free storage on my Google Account. However, this doesn’t mean I want to spend even more on a service I only started using because Google promised unlimited free storage for compressed images. As I watched my storage quota pass the halfway mark for my current 100GB plan, I decided it was time to take action. But Google doesn’t exactly make it easy to manage your Google Photos images and videos. Besides bulk deletion and compression, you mostly have to sort through your files yourself.
